protocol_description: Fresh small MACE MLIP initialization; full 80-atom graph and equal mean pooling, uniform stored-row sampling, 12 epochs. Fixed spatial/0.1 ps temporal VICReg; TDA80 head frozen for five epochs, active from epoch six. No forecast/nuisance loss or balancing. Select lowest fixed validation loss among epochs 6–12. Frozen probes and the standard encoder-only static Al analysis follow. Single seed; static Al includes training ancestors.
